source: NERDC Nigeria Basic Education Curriculum (revised), Lower Basic — Primary 3 Mathematics & English Studies

skills.subject: math
skills.label: Whole numbers up to 999
skills.summary: Read, write, count and order whole numbers up to 999 and identify place value (hundreds, tens, units).
skills.source: NERDC Primary Mathematics P3 — Theme 1: Number and Numeration

skills.subject: math
skills.label: Addition of 3-digit numbers with regrouping
skills.summary: Add two and three 3-digit numbers with and without regrouping, including word problems within 999.
skills.source: NERDC Primary Mathematics P3 — Theme 1: Basic Operations (Addition)

skills.subject: math
skills.label: Subtraction of 3-digit numbers with regrouping
skills.summary: Subtract 3-digit numbers with and without regrouping and solve related word problems.
skills.source: NERDC Primary Mathematics P3 — Theme 1: Basic Operations (Subtraction)

skills.subject: math
skills.label: Multiplication of whole numbers by 1 to 9
skills.summary: Multiply 2-digit numbers by a 1-digit number (1–9) using repeated addition and the multiplication table.
skills.source: NERDC Primary Mathematics P3 — Theme 1: Basic Operations (Multiplication)

skills.subject: math
skills.label: Fractions: halves, quarters and thirds
skills.summary: Identify, represent and compare simple fractions (1/2, 1/3, 1/4) of objects and sets.
skills.source: NERDC Primary Mathematics P3 — Theme 1: Fractions

skills.subject: ela
skills.label: Reading comprehension of short passages
skills.summary: Read short passages aloud with fluency and answer literal and simple inferential questions.
skills.source: NERDC English Studies P3 — Theme: Reading

skills.subject: ela
skills.label: Construct simple and correct sentences
skills.summary: Use nouns, pronouns and verbs to construct grammatically correct simple sentences.
skills.source: NERDC English Studies P3 — Theme: Grammar

skills.subject: ela
skills.label: Guided composition (3–4 sentences)
skills.summary: Write a guided composition of 3–4 connected sentences on a familiar topic.
skills.source: NERDC English Studies P3 — Theme: Writing
